removed_before_review.sentence: The record hypothesizes that testing aboard the ISS can demonstrate the first-time improvement in understanding cool flame kinetics. (PSI-159 record: hypothesis)
removed_before_review.reason: Not what the record says. PSI-159 HYP-1 says testing aboard the ISS 'can demonstrate the following for the first time, contributing to an improved understanding of cool flame kinetics': what is first is the list of demonstrations that follows, and the improved understanding is what they contribute to. The sentence makes the improvement itself the first-time result. Every code gate passed it, so it is removed here; its slot shows the quoted NASA sentence.
